name: What are the common challenges when installing period correct molding in older homes?

mainEntity.name: What are the common challenges when installing period correct molding in older homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing period correct molding in older homes presents unique challenges due to factors like uneven walls, settling foundations, and varied original construction methods. Walls and ceilings in older properties are rarely perfectly straight or plumb, requiring careful scribing and fitting of molding to ensure tight seams and a seamless appearance. Additionally, older homes may have lead paint or asbestos, which requires careful handling. Our team is experienced in working with the nuances of historic structures, addressing these challenges with precision and appropriate safety measures to achieve a high-quality, period-accurate finish. Careful preparation and skilled craftsmanship are key.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges in older homes include uneven walls and settling, requiring precise fitting and careful handling of materials like lead paint. Our team is experienced in addressing these issues for a high-quality finish.
